[3] Mason Wilson Gamble (born January 16, 1986) is an American former actor known for his portrayal of Dennis Mitchell in the 1993 film "Dennis the Menace", a role he got after beating out a reported 20,000 children who had auditioned, and as Jason Schwartzman's sidekick, Dirk Calloway, in Wes Anderson and Owen Wilson's critically acclaimed 1998 film "Rushmore".
[4] Bored to Death is an American comedy series that ran on HBO from September 20, 2009 to November 28, 2011.
